title: English Grammar and Vocabulary
description: A short practice exam covering parts of speech, verb tenses, punctuation, and vocabulary.
subject: English

questions.text: Which word is the verb in this sentence: "Maya reads every evening"?

options: The students books are on the desk.
The student's books are on the desk.
